frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes the notion of a FRONTMOST / FORE-region that functions as the source-seat of an entity — the leading front-part where its content is held foremost and from which movement or content issues/proceeds forth. In the nominal form it names the chest as this frontal holding-seat of the self; in the verbal forms it names the act of proceeding/being driven forth from a source-point.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes the notion of a FRONTMOST / FORE-region that functions as the source-seat of an entity — the leading front-part where its content is held foremost and from which movement or content issues/proceeds forth. In the nominal form it names the chest as this frontal holding-seat of the self; in the verbal forms it names the act of proceeding/being driven forth from a source-point.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: Across the 44 noun occurrences صدر/صدور is the chest — but the data consistently exploits it not as mere anatomy but as the FRONTAL SEAT that holds and can release a person's inner content. It is repeatedly the locus of what is contained: 'ما فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ' (100:10; 3:29; 3:154), 'ذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ' — what the chests possess, known only to God (recurring formula: 3:119, 31:23, 35:38, 39:7, 42:24, 57:6, 64:4, 67:13, 5:7, 8:43), 'مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ' (27:74; 28:69), 'وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ' (40:19; 3:118). It holds ghill/grudge that can be extracted ('نَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ', 15:47; 7:43), rahba/dread (59:13), kibr/arrogance (40:56), need (40:80; 59:9), and is a target of whispering ('يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ', 114:5) and healing ('شِفَآءٌ لِّمَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ', 10:57; 'يَشْفِ صُدُورَ قَوْمٍ', 9:14). Crucially the chest is presented as the CONTAINER whose fore-position holds the heart: 'ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ' (22:46) — the qalb sits inside the sadr. As a seat it has capacity that can be constricted or opened: 'يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ' (15:97; 26:13), 'ضَآئِقٌ بِهِۦ صَدْرُكَ' (11:12), 'حَصِرَتْ صُدُورُهُمْ' (4:90), 'صَدْرِكَ حَرَجٌ' (7:2), versus opening 'ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى' (20:25), 'أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ' (94:1), 'شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ' (39:22; 6:125), 'يَجْعَلْ صَدْرَهُۥ ضَيِّقًا' (6:125). Everywhere the sadr is the frontal seat where the self's states RESIDE at the fore and may be concealed or released. The two verbs make the 'issue-forth-from-source' dimension explicit: 99:6 'يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا' — people proceed/come forth (from the graves/reckoning) in scattered groups; 28:23 (form IV) 'حَتَّىٰ يُصْدِرَ ٱلرِّعَآءُ' — until the shepherds drive their flocks forth (away from the water). The bridge holding all 46 together is the schema FRONT/FORE = SOURCE-POINT-OF-EGRESS: the chest is the leading front-region that serves as origin/seat of what the person holds and lets out; the verb صدر is the pure act of proceeding forth from such a source-point. Both revolve around the same fore-source-and-egress core; only the profiled facet shifts by form.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Subtracted (a) FORM: N (صدر/صدور) profiles the front-region entity = chest-seat; V form I (99:6 يَصْدُرُ) profiles the intransitive act of proceeding-forth-from-source; V form IV (28:23 يُصْدِرَ) adds causation = drive/make proceed forth. The abstract residue (front-region-as-source-of-egress) is what survives after removing these derivational overlays. (b) CONSTRUCTION: 'فِى صُدُورِ + X' (locative: content resting IN the seat, e.g. 114:5, 29:10, 40:56), 'بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ' (attributive: what the seat POSSESSES), transitive shaping verbs (شرح/يجعل + صدر as patient), and the water-egress frame of 28:23 all supply directional/relational vectors that are NOT the root's; the root only supplies the fore-seat/source node they operate on. (c) PARTICIPANTS: humans' chests, the Prophet's chest, believers'/hypocrites'/disbelievers' chests, God as knower of ذات الصدور, shepherds+flocks (28:23), resurrected people (99:6) — none of these introduce the semantic constant. (d) CONTEXT: eschatological (99:6), narrative/pastoral (28:23), consolation (94:1; 20:25), polemic (3:118; 40:56), omniscience formulae — contextual, not root-borne. Invariant after subtraction: FRONTMOST SEAT / SOURCE-POINT from which content is held-foremost and issues forth.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: The hardest cases are the pure CONCEALMENT verses — 40:19 'وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ', 27:74/28:69 'مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ', 3:118 'مَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ' — because 'concealing/holding in' looks like the OPPOSITE of 'issuing forth,' which threatens a residue built partly on egress. Reconciliation: the invariant is not 'egress' per se but 'front-region-as-SOURCE-SEAT'; concealment is precisely the seat retaining its content at the fore rather than releasing it. The same seat that can conceal (تُخفي) is the one that can be made to release (نُزع الغل, شفاء لما في الصدور, وسوسة entering it) — holding and issuing are the two poles of one source-seat function, so these verses instantiate rather than contradict the core. The verb 28:23 (drive flocks forth from water) is the mirror case where egress is explicit and 'chest' is absent; it too fits the fore-source-of-egress schema, confirming the abstraction is genuinely shared and not smuggled in from the noun.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Strongest alternative: the root's core is simply 'chest/breast (the anatomical front of the trunk),' with the two motion verbs treated as a separate (historically cognate) sense 'to proceed/depart from a watering-place.' This fits 44/46 trivially. Internal arbitration: the unity mandate forbids splitting into homonyms unless forced, and nothing forces it — 99:6 'يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ' (proceed forth) and the noun share a recoverable abstraction (front/fore → leading-out from a source-point), classically the same node that yields مَصْدَر 'source.' The 'just chest' hypothesis cannot cover the 2 verbs without positing homonymy, whereas the fore-source-of-egress abstraction covers all 46 with one node. Since an internally-attested bridge (the chest as the fore-part/leading region; the verb as leading-forth) links them, the more unified hypothesis is preferred over the homonym-split. The abstraction is admittedly thinner than the concrete 'chest,' which is why the direction is a conceptual center rather than a single surface gloss.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: (1) قلب qlb 'heart' — the responsive cognitive/affective organ. Sdr is DISTINCT as the frontal enclosure that CONTAINS the qalb, made explicit in 22:46 'ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلَّتِى فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ' and by the division of labor where faith rests in the qalb (16:106 'قَلْبُهُۥ مُطْمَئِنٌّ') while the sadr is what gets opened/constricted to receive it (39:22 'شَرَحَ ... صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ'; 6:125). Falsifiability: if صدر were used as the direct agent of understanding/belief interchangeably with قلب (e.g. 'صدر' that reasons or is sealed), the container-vs-organ distinction would fail — no such use occurs. (2) نفس nfs 'self' — the whole self; sadr is the localized fore-seat within it (contrast 3:154 'مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ' with 'يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم'). (3) بطن 'belly/inner-lower' and ظهر 'back' — spatial cognates; sadr is specifically the FORE, distinguishing it from rear/lower interior. (4) For the verb, ورد wrd 'go down to water / arrive' is the lexical antonym-partner; صدر = proceed-forth-FROM, ورد = come-TO. Falsifiability condition: an occurrence using the verb صدر to mean 'arrive/come toward,' or the noun for a hindmost/rear region, would falsify the front/source-of-egress residue; none exists.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — FRONTMOST-REGION-AS-SOURCE-SEAT-OF-EGRESS — is recoverable across all 46 occurrences. It is directly surface-present in the two verbs (99:6 proceeding forth; 28:23 driving forth from a source) and in the dominant noun uses where the chest is profiled as the frontal seat that holds, conceals, receives, is constricted/opened, and releases the self's content (10:57, 15:47, 27:74, 40:19, 22:46, 20:25, 39:22, etc.). Strength is MODERATE rather than STRONG because the unifying node is not one uniform concrete gloss: in the noun the 'egress/proceeding' facet is latent (the chest is often profiled as a holding container), and in the verbs the 'front/chest' facet is latent — so unity rests on an internally-attested conceptual bridge (front/fore ↔ source-point-of-egress) rather than on a single surface sense recoverable identically everywhere. The hardest tension — concealment verses (40:19; 27:74) appearing to invert 'issuing' — is genuinely reconciled by framing the invariant as the source-SEAT whose holding and releasing are two poles of one function, not by forcing. No occurrence remains unreconciled; inconsistent_refs is empty and clean universal presence is claimed with the honest qualification that the center is a conceptual node, not a surface constant.

adversarial_verification.notes:
REFUTATION ATTEMPT. The candidate proposes a single overarching schema FRONT/FORE = SOURCE-POINT-OF-EGRESS, then quietly splits it into two facets 'by form': noun = frontal holding-seat, verb = proceeding forth. The two-facet escape hatch is what lets it survive, and it is exactly what an adversary should flag.

STRONGEST FINDINGS:

(1) Over-breadth in the noun facet ('front' + 'egress' are imposed, not exploited). Across the 42 concealment/knowledge formulas (ذات الصدور: 3:119,31:23,35:38,39:7,42:24,57:6,64:4,67:13,5:7,8:43; ما في الصدور: 100:10,3:29,3:154,29:10; ما تخفي/تكن الصدور: 3:118,40:19,27:74,28:69) the salient exploited feature is INTERIORITY + CONCEALMENT — content that is KEPT hidden and known only to God. This is the ANTITHESIS of 'source from which content issues/proceeds forth.' The candidate absorbs this by wording the noun facet 'held foremost AND can be released,' i.e. it counts both retention and release as confirmation. Nothing in these verses profiles 'frontness' either; anatomical frontness is etymologically true but does no semantic work. So the specific gloss (fore + egress) is under-determined/imposed; only a generic 'interior seat/container of the self's states' is actually warranted.

(2) The capacity/volume cluster resists even the loose 'holding-seat' reading and shows zero egress: 4:90 حصرت صدورهم (idiom for reluctance to fight — constricted breast = cowardice, no content, no source), 15:97 & 26:13 يضيق صدر (distress = shrinking volume), 11:12 ضائق به صدرك, 7:2 حرج في صدرك, 94:1 & 20:25 نشرح/اشرح الصدر (receptive EXPANSION, the opposite of issuing-out), 17:51 يكبر في صدوركم (a creation too great to CONCEIVE in the breasts). These profile the chest as an emotional/cognitive CAPACITY-space, not a 'source-seat of egress' — they fit the candidate only by relabeling 'space' as 'seat,' which is fiat.

(3) Release, where present, is by an EXTERNAL agent, not the chest as source: نزعنا (15:47, 7:43 — WE removed), يشف/شفاء (9:14, 10:57 — healing done TO the chest). So even the 'lets out' claim is not the chest functioning as an egress-source.

HARDEST CASES / RESOLUTION: The two verbs (99:6 يصدر الناس 'proceed forth in scattered groups'; 28:23 form-IV يصدر الرعاء 'drive the flocks forth from water') do genuinely mean egress/proceeding-forth, and classical lexicography links صدر-chest (the front) with صدر-to-go-forth (from watering) via 'front,' so this is NOT unbridgeable homonymy — hence not REFUTED. But the bridge is etymological, not usage-driven: within the Qur'anic data the noun (interior container of hidden states + capacity) and verb (motion outward) are cleanly distinct facets, and the grand 'fore-source-and-egress core' is a synthesis reachable only from outside the corpus.

FALSIFIABILITY: marked false. The dual wording ('held foremost AND may be released') plus the by-form facet split means retention, concealment, expansion, constriction, external extraction, AND literal proceeding-forth all count as confirmation — there is no occurrence the schema would reject. An unfalsifiable-by-elasticity core.

DISTINCTIVENESS: marked true despite the above. The one thing the data does support distinctly is sadr = the enclosing BREAST/container vs. its neighbors — decisively so in 22:46 (القلوب التي في الصدور: the qalb sits INSIDE the sadr). Sadr = the encasing seat/cavity; qalb = the organ within; nafs = the self. That container-vs-contents contrast is real and discriminating. The failure is not distinctiveness but the specific 'front + egress' framing being over-broad and unfalsifiable.

VERDICT: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED — a genuine, distinct unity (chest as interior holding-seat of the self, with a related motion-forth verb) is present, but the frozen candidate over-specifies it with 'front' and 'source-point-of-egress' components that the noun data do not exploit and in the concealment/capacity verses actively resist, saved only by an unfalsifiable by-form facet split.
